newsitem.title: USA: U.S. State Dept worker hurt by exploding can.
newsitem.headline: U.S. State Dept worker hurt by exploding can.

text.p: A U.S. State Department employee was slightly hurt and the bomb squad was called when an aerosol can exploded inside a diplomatic pouch Monday, the department said.

But the blast was not a bomb or a bombing attempt, spokesman Nicholas Burns told reporters. The Washington D.C. Bomb Squad was called "just as a precaution ... but they definitely determined it was not a bomb," he said.
"Somebody put an aerosol can inside a pouch. We don't know who yet. You're not supposed to do those things," he added.
Burns said the female employee was moving the pouch -- a bag containing diplomatic documents and articles -- in a mail room when the can exploded.
She suffered bruising to the arm and leg but was released after treatment within the department, Burns said.
